person_note: The eligible narrative content is a collection of prose fairy-tale retellings, and the diagnostic quotes span Red Riding Hood, Rapunzel, Cinderella, and The Three Little Pigs in consistent external third-person narration. The author-hosted excerpt independently confirms that structure for Red Riding Hood, while the complete accessible transcription and a contemporaneous review corroborate additional tales. I/you forms in dialogue are local character speech, and the first-person introduction in the full transcription is paratext, so neither creates alternation. The two isolated comic rhymes have uncertain edition provenance and are nondiagnostic. The main residual limitation is that the whole-book transcription is not an authorized publisher source, but agreement among the Tier A excerpt, multiple supplied story passages, the cross-collection transcription, and the independent review supports THIRD with high confidence.
